title: That woman screaming at night? It's a fox 🦊😱
caption:
Heard a scream outside at 2am? Don't panic. Probably a fox 🦊
Tag someone who's heard it 👇
first_comment: Have you heard a fox scream? 😱👇
sources: The Mammal Society (UK) and the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds / The Wildlife Trusts: the vixen's scream, mostly in the winter breeding season (December-February)
Newton-Fisher N. et al. (1993) 'Structure and function of red fox Vulpes vulpes vocalisations', Bioacoustics 5: 1-31 (barks, screams, gekkering)
